ValidationRule.description: Requires a RIM EAA greater than 0 whenever RIM_BU__c is checked. Applies to every save except insert, so Lead conversion still succeeds. Skipped for users with the Bypass_Opportunity_Validation permission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation), NOT(ISNEW()), RIM_BU__c = TRUE, OR(ISBLANK(RIM_EAA__c), RIM_EAA__c <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter a RIM EAA greater than 0 when RIM BU is checked.
